name: @todex/protocol
description: Shared TodeX protocol layer consumed by TodeX_desktop and TodeX_web via @todex/protocol/* path aliases.

scripts.test:unit: tsc --ignoreConfig src/*.ts --outDir dist/unit/lib --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict && node --test tests/unit/*.test.cjs
scripts.check:protocol: tsc --ignoreConfig src/todex.ts src/netinfo.d.ts --outDir dist/protocol-check --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node scripts/check-protocol.cjs
